div.head: II Cn 23.1
div.ab: ⁊ gecyðe seo gewitnes þæt on Godes helde ⁊ on hlafordes, þæt heo him on soðre gewitnesse sy, swa heo hit eagum oferseah ⁊ earum oferhyrde, þæt he hit mid rihte begeate.
⁊ gecyðe se gewitnesse þæt on Godes helde ⁊ on hlafordes, þæt heo him on soðre gewitnesse sy, swa heo hit eagum oferseah ⁊ earum oferhyrde, þæt he hit mid rihte begeate.
Et inueritent hoc ipsi testes in fide Dei et domini sui, quod ei in uero testimonio sint, sicut oculis superuiderint et aure superaudierint, quod recte hoc adquisiuit.
⁊ gecyðe seo gewitnysse þæt on Godes helde ⁊ on his hlafordes, þæt heo him on soðre gewitnysse si, swa heo hít eagum ofersæh ⁊ earum oferhyrdon, þæt he hit mid rihte begeate.

And the witnesses, as they wish to obtain the favour of God and of their lord, shall declare that, in bearing testimony on his behalf to the effect that he acquired it legally, they are speaking the truth, in accordance with what they saw with their eyes and heard with their ears.
And that witness is to declare, by God’s favour and the lord’s, that they stand with him in true testimony, as they saw with their eyes and heard with their ears, that he obtained it rightly.

Und es erkläre die Zeugenschaft bei Gottes und des Herrn Gnade Folgendes: dass sie in wahrhaftem Zeugniss für ihn stehe, wie sie es mit Augen sah und mit Ohren hörte, dass er jenes rechtmässig erworben habe.
And let the witness declare, by God's favour and his lord's, that it stands in true witness for him, as it saw with its eyes and heard with its ears, that he acquired it rightfully.
